problem:
The position vector $r$ of a particle $P$ (relative to a fixed origin $O$) at time $t$ is given by

$$
r=⟨7{t}^{2},\,-18⟩,\,t>0.
$$

Calculate the components of the velocity vector $v$ at time $t=5.$ Do not round the answers.

$v(5)=⟨${{field-1}},
{{field-2}}$⟩$

feedback.problem:
The position vector $r$ of a particle $P$ (relative to a fixed origin $O$) at time $t$ is given by

$$
r=⟨\frac{7}{t+1},\,\frac{5t}{{t}^{2}+1}⟩,\,t>0.
$$

Calculate the components of the velocity vector $v$ at time $t=2.$ Do not round the answers.

$v(2)=⟨${{field-1}},
{{field-2}}$⟩$
feedback.worked_solution:
The particle's velocity vector is given by the derivative of its position vector:

$$
\begin{aligned}v & =\frac{\text{d}r}{\text{d}t} \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t},\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}t}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\frac{7}{t+1}),\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\frac{5t}{{t}^{2}+1})⟩ \\  & =⟨-\frac{7}{(t+1)^{2}},\frac{5-5{t}^{2}}{({t}^{2}+1)^{2}}⟩\end{aligned}
$$

To find the velocity when $t=2,$ we substitute into the above:

$$
\begin{aligned}v(2) & =⟨-\frac{7}{(2+1)^{2}},\,\frac{5-5(2)^{2}}{((2)^{2}+1)^{2}}⟩ \\  & =⟨-\frac{7}{9},\,-\frac{3}{5}⟩\end{aligned}
$$
